Here are the cited observations organized by scope:

---

## Repository-Wide Validation Mechanisms

### CI System: Woodpecker CI

The project uses [Woodpecker CI](https://woodpecker-ci.org/) (not GitHub Actions) with three pipeline definitions under [`.woodpecker/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/poezio-poezio@9c528ac2f3e2cdad01b8c72dbcebbdd37c38fef5/-/tree/.woodpecker):

#### 1. Lint pipeline — [`.woodpecker/lint.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/poezio-poezio@9c528ac2f3e2cdad01b8c72dbcebbdd37c38fef5/-/blob/.woodpecker/lint.yml)

Triggers on `push`, `tag`, `release`, `manual`. Runs four tools sequentially against `./poezio` and `./plugins`:

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `flake8` | Style/syntax lint (PEP 8 subset) |
| `typos` | Spell-checking of source text |
| `mypy --ignore-missing-imports` | Static type checking |
| `pylint -E` | Error-only pylint (fatal errors only) |

The `-E` flag on pylint means only error-category messages (not warnings or conventions) block the pipeline. Full pylint score threshold is `fail-under = 9` ([`pyproject.toml` L127](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/poezio-poezio@9c528ac2f3e2cdad01b8c72dbcebbdd37c38fef5/-/blob/pyproject.toml?L127)).

#### 2. Test pipeline — [`.woodpecker/test.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/poezio-poezio@9c528ac2f3e2cdad01b8c72dbcebbdd37c38fef5/-/blob/.woodpecker/test.yml)

Triggers on `push`, `tag`, `release`, `manual`. Runs `py.test -v test/` in a **matrix** across Python versions: `3.11`, `3.12`, `3.13`, `3.14`. Uses `uv` for environment management and installs slixmpp from Codeberg HEAD (`git+https://codeberg.org/poezio/slixmpp.git`), meaning the test matrix tracks upstream slixmpp's current state, not a pinned release.

#### 3. Container pipeline — [`.woodpecker/container.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/poezio-poezio@9c528ac2f3e2cdad01b8c72dbcebbdd37c38fef5/-/blob/.woodpecker/container.yaml)

Triggers on `push`/`tag`/`release` to `main` branch only, with a path filter (`Dockerfile`, `poezio/**/*`, `plugins/*`, `.woodpecker/*`). Also runs on a cron schedule named `container`. Builds and pushes a multi-arch (`linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`) Docker image to `codeberg.org/poezio/poezio:latest`.

---

### Linter Configuration

All linter configs are co-located in [`pyproject.toml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/poezio-poezio@9c528ac2f3e2cdad01b8c72dbcebbdd37c38fef5/-/blob/pyproject.toml):

- **flake8** ([L80-L85](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/poezio-poezio@9c528ac2f3e2cdad01b8c72dbcebbdd37c38fef5/-/blob/pyproject.toml?L80-L85)): Ignores `E501` (line length) and `E266` (block comment format) globally. Per-file ignores: `hsluv.py` (E741 ambiguous variable name) and `theming.py` (E241 whitespace after comma).
- **mypy** ([L87-L93](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/poezio-poezio@9c528ac2f3e2cdad01b8c72dbcebbdd37c38fef5/-/blob/pyproject.toml?L87-L93)): `strict = true` with selective relaxations: `warn_return_any = false`, `disallow_untyped_calls = false`, `disallow_untyped_defs = false`, `disallow_subclassing_any = false`.
- **pylint** ([L96-L654](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/poezio-poezio@9c528ac2f3e2cdad01b8c72dbcebbdd37c38fef5/-/blob/pyproject.toml?L96-L654)): Extensive config. Notable settings: `max-args = 5`, `max-attributes = 7`, `max-line-length = 100`, `py-version = "3.14"`, `bad-names = ["foo", "bar", "baz", "toto", "tutu", "tata"]`, `notes = ["FIXME", "XXX", "TODO"]`.
- **typos** ([`typos.toml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/poezio-poezio@9c528ac2f3e2cdad01b8c72dbcebbdd37c38fef5/-/blob/typos.toml)): XMPP/French domain-specific word allowlist (e.g., `muc`, `allo`, `toi`).

---

### Test Suite

Thirteen test files exist under [`test/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/poezio-poezio@9c528ac2f3e2cdad01b8c72dbcebbdd37c38fef5/-/tree/test):

```
test/test_common.py
test/test_completion.py
test/test_config.py
test/test_events.py
test/test_logger.py
test/test_poopt.py
test/test_tabs.py
test/test_text_buffer.py
test/test_theming.py
test/test_user.py
test/test_windows.py
test/test_xhtml.py
test/test_ui/test_funcs.py
test/test_ui/test_render.py
test/test_ui/test_types.py
```

Coverage spans: config parsing, event system, logger, tab behavior, text buffer, theming, user model, XHTML rendering, UI types and rendering, and poopt (C extension).

---

### Local Developer Targets

[`Makefile`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/poezio-poezio@9c528ac2f3e2cdad01b8c72dbcebbdd37c38fef5/-/blob/Makefile) mirrors CI steps:
- `make lint` — runs `flake8`, `typos`, `mypy`, `pylint -E`
- `make test` — runs `py.test test/`
- `make release` — clones, checks out tag, builds docs, produces `.tar.xz` and `.tar.gz` archives

---

### Anomaly: `.github/copilot-instructions.md`

[`.github/copilot-instructions.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/poezio-poezio@9c528ac2f3e2cdad01b8c72dbcebbdd37c38fef5/-/blob/.github/copilot-instructions.md) is the only file under `.github/`. It does not define any GitHub Actions workflows, CODEOWNERS, branch protection rules, PR templates, or issue templates. The file contains persona instructions for an AI coding assistant and is unrelated to CI or code-review enforcement. No GitHub Actions workflows exist in this repository at this revision.

---

### Change-Level Evidence (commit history)

**Reverts** visible in default-branch history:

- `fe9992e` — Merge of that revert via MR !140
- `92f32c9` — Revert of "Properly pass JID to config.get_by_tabname" ("breaks stuff")
- `80d18e6` — Revert of PEP 639 license classifier (setuptools compatibility)
- `0b89168` — Revert of `update/launch.sh` uv requirement change
- `4edf690` — Double-revert of privatetab MUC-PM marker
- `68c0c3e` — Revert of bash strict mode in `update.sh`

**Follow-up fixes explicitly tied to prior commits:**
- `0442290` — "fix typo introduced in previous commit / thanks, type checking" ([link](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/poezio-poezio@9c528ac2f3e2cdad01b8c72dbcebbdd37c38fef5/-/commit/0442290310303d9d1053bd9c451ffc7f9deded45)) — type checker caught a regression introduced one commit earlier
- `82c2914` — "embed: fix /embed's compat with /upload / broken in 85a0a2c21" ([link](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/poezio-poezio@9c528ac2f3e2cdad01b8c72dbcebbdd37c38fef5/-/commit/82c29143528cbbdaa0b82c3de098a3c5fc7f3ef9))
- `4548e0a` — "fix: remove extra blank line / Thanks flake8!" ([link](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/poezio-poezio@9c528ac2f3e2cdad01b8c72dbcebbdd37c38fef5/-/commit/4548e0adc427ee31c10e71ecd319bfd95f21b5b3)) — flake8 credited directly
- `5c19327` — "tests: fix parse_message test with the __dict__ removal" — test was broken by a separate refactor

**Merge request workflow** (pre-2021 period): Multiple commits reference GitLab MR numbers (`!139`, `!140`, `!145–!155`), indicating a code-review merge-request workflow was in use at that time via the upstream Codeberg/GitLab instance. Recent commits (2021–2026) do not carry MR references, suggesting direct push to main.
